hack.root_cause: Governance-introduced bug — updated Comptroller vault incorrectly distributed COMP rewards; any user could call `drip()` to refill the vulnerable vault from the Reservoir
hack.description: Compound's Proposal 62 governance upgrade contained a bug that let any user claim excess COMP rewards, and the protocol's own `drip()` function let anyone keep refilling the vulnerable vault while the fix waited 7 days to pass governance.
